line.name: La Flor Dominicana Ligero
line.description: A separate numbered series from the already-listed 'Double Ligero' line - filenames use a plain 'L' prefix (L300, L400) rather than 'DL,' and research confirms these are genuinely two different LFD lines, not a numbering quirk of the same line. Offered in Natural and Oscuro (darkest Ecuadorian Sumatra) wrapper styles, sometimes called 'Ligero Oscuro.'
line.status: current (appears to be a longer-running regular-production line; exact launch year not confirmed this session)
